command: set -euo pipefail; echo '=== ESP-IDF 5.5.1 ENV SETUP ==='; IDF="$HOME/esp/esp-idf"; test "$(git -C "$IDF" describe --tags --always --dirty)" = 'v5.5.1'; "$IDF/install.sh" esp32s3; source "$IDF/export.sh"; command -v idf.py; idf.py --version; test "$(idf.py --version)" = 'ESP-IDF v5.5.1'; echo 'IDF_ENV_READY'
